entities.summary: St. Nicholas' Church is a Russian Orthodox church in the village of Nikolaevka, Neklinovsky District, Rostov Oblast, Russia, within the Diocese of Rostov and Novocherkassk. Dedicated to Saint Nicholas, it was built in the mid-19th century.
